question: Which of the following festivals is mainly associated with Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Bihu**

 
 
• The Bihu dance is an indigenous folk dance from the Indian state of Assam related to the Bihu festival and an important part of Assamese culture.
 
• The Bihu dance takes its name from the Bohag Bihu festival also called Rangali Bihu,the national festival of Assam, which celebrates the Assamese New Year.
